summary: Frontend-only validation completed for Lompat Langit across responsive layouts, core gameplay flows, mechanics, persistence paths, economy/missions, PNG asset policy, and service worker offline revisit. Most requested flows passed; one storage-status UI bug was confirmed.

ui_bugs.issue: After a storage failure event, status text switches to warning and does not revert when storage recovery event fires.

test_report_links: mcp_browser_automation runs (no persisted test script file)
action_items: Fix progress-saved event handling to restore normal saved-note text when detail=false (storage recovered).
Main agent should re-run a quick UI check for saved-note transition true -> false.
critical_code_review_comments: In /app/public/js/sky/main.js, progress-saved listener only handles failure branch and never resets note on recovery, causing stale warning state.
pagehide save behavior can overwrite direct localStorage manual edits during test setup; seed via store object for deterministic tests.
seed_data_creation: Used in-browser store mutation for deterministic UI checks (balance/mission/progress state).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified: responsive routes (320x568, 390x844, 430x932, 1920x800), tutorial back/play re-entry, keyboard controls (Arrows/A), swipe/buttons control modes, pause/resume/restart/home, blur-triggered pause, world/platform/enemy mechanics via module-level checks, Bintang persistence on finish(abandoned), shop pricing/deduction, mission claim/tier progression, duplicate run finalization guard, PNG-only runtime assets, no SVG DOM, service worker cache key and offline revisit. Only confirmed defect: .saved-note recovery text not restored.
rca of the issue: Repro: dispatch CustomEvent('progress-saved', {detail:true}) then CustomEvent('progress-saved', {detail:false}). Expected footer note to return to default success text. Actual: remains warning. Root cause: /app/public/js/sky/main.js listener updates .saved-note only when e.detail is truthy and has no else branch to restore default text. Mitigation: set explicit default message when detail=false and preserve icon markup consistently.
